beats.headline: Where'd you get that chain
beats.text: The residents' wheelchair train runs on one glowing chain, about three hundred feet long, from Chris through every car and back to Imani. Carl asks where the chain came from. Imani had a scroll called Yog's Special Chain, or something like that, out of some Gold box. She could pick any length up to something crazy, like a thousand feet. It's light as a feather, but the chain only lasts thirty hours.

beats.headline: The last car dangles
beats.text: Gravity reverses. The rage elemental's spell does not reach all the way to the safe room door, so the last platform, still connected to the rest of the cars by Imani's magic chain, dangles upward, having thrown off its only remaining rider. Carl pulls himself to his feet and keeps running, upside down along the ceiling of the hallway, toward the crumpled form of Mrs. McGibbons.

beats.headline: A bola off the launcher
beats.text: Everything in the hallway is ash; the train cars and abandoned wheelchairs are gone. The only thing that survived is the long, three-hundred-foot length of glittering, magical chain, which Carl grabbed earlier. Weighted at either end, it waits in one of the two chambers built on either side of the bomb on the trailer, the levers beside Donut's chair. Drop the bola! She pulls the black lever and Imani's chain snakes away through the chamber. Far behind, the elemental stops: it has been ensnared by the chain. When it comes out of the smoke at the stairwell, a length of chain is still attached to its back leg, and its health is in the red.

beats.headline: Holding up a cart
beats.text: Imani still has a few of those chain-making scrolls, and Carl asks her to use them. Several piles of the magical chain sit coiled and ready while she asks if he is sure. Within the hour the chain lifts the back end of the interdiction cart into the air from a five-legged crane over the stairwells, and it does not break. They lock it in place, the whole cart hanging vertically like a prize fish on display, and anchor the front with more chain so it won't swing.
